property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, C.transfer(...) always returns true when the call completes (does not revert); the mutant inverts that return causing some successful calls to return false and thus violate this rule.
change_summary: Invert the final return value: return false when loop completes and true if loop is skipped (so successful runs return false), changing observable return for successful calls.
